_doc: What the game says when a hit meets a creature's weakness, its resistance or what it shrugs off, or fire puts a beast to flight (src/affinity.py; Brandon, bug bash 3.3.2: 'a whole set of pokemon style messages, so you know it when you are blocked or effective'). One line per action, chosen at random from the pool; the _many pools when several creatures were struck the same way. {name} is the creature with its article at a sentence start, {the} the same mid-sentence, {word} what met it (fire, silver, a cutting blow). status_immune: the line when an effect cannot take hold on a creature by its nature (Monster.add_effect, status_immune in monsters.json), by effect; status_weak: the line when one takes hold easily (status_weak). {effect} is the effect's name.
weak: Right where it hurts! {word_cap} finds {the}'s weakness.
{name} shrieks. It was never made to take {word}.
A telling blow! {name} has no answer to {word}.
{word_cap} bites deep. {name} is weak to it!
That is the way to hurt {the}: {word}!
resisted: {name} hardly notices. Try something other than {word}.
The blow lands, but {the} takes little of it: it resists {word}.
{name} was made to weather {word}. Not very effective.
shrugs_off: {name} shrugs off {word}. Almost nothing gets through.
{word_cap} goes through {the} like a hand through smoke.
Hardly a scratch! {name} was never going to fall to {word}.
{name} does not even slow down. {word_cap} is the wrong tool here.
fire_fright: {name} yelps and backs away from the fire!
weak_many: It's super effective! None of them can bear {word}.
resisted_many: Not very effective... {word} hardly troubles them.
It's not very effective: they all resist {word}.
shrugs_off_many: They shrug off {word}. Almost nothing gets through.
fire_fright_many: The fire puts them to flight!
They shy from the flame and scatter!

charmed: {name} has no heart for the charm to win.
confused: There is no mind in {the} to confuse.
sleeping: {name} never sleeps. The spell finds nothing to lull.
poisoned: Poison has nothing in {the} to work on.
{name} has no blood for the poison to ride.
paralyzed: Nothing in {the} can be held still.
immobilized: Nothing can hold {the}: it slips free.
stunned: {name} does not reel. There is nothing in it to stun.
diseased: {name} has no flesh for the sickness to take.
default: {name} is untouched by it: {effect} cannot take hold of such a thing.

sleeping: {name} drops at once into a deep sleep.
